title: Tier 2 research prototype — month 1 (segment, embed, simulate on the corpus)
summary: First Tier 2 research spike per the research/tier2 charter: on the corpus only, segment objects from the splat, embed them for simulation, and simulate at least three object classes, reporting per-scan compute cost and mobile frame-time against the SPEC §5 metrics. Monthly compute AUTH required before any GPU spend.

Per-scan preprocessing cost and added mobile frame-time are measured on the reference iPhone against R2 and R3.
Runs only after the month's compute AUTH is approved; spend stays within the approved line and is paused on the Owner's word.
